qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Mission-critical niche industrial leaders (Nord-Lock safety fasteners, Swegon HVAC, Assa Abloy access solutions) have severe customer switching costs, low cost-to-value ratios, and demonstrated multi-cycle pricing power >= inflation.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Premier Swedish industrial compounder combining wholly-owned niche B2B market leaders (Nord-Lock, Swegon, Hultafors) with anchor stakes in world-class listed compounders (Assa Abloy, Sweco). High switching costs and negligible cost-to-value ratio provide consistent pricing power. Conservative balance sheet with low net debt/NAV (<10%). [5-10Y g: organic volume 4.0% + pricing power 2.5% + bolt-on M&A 2.5%]
qualitative.evidence: Operating tangible ROIC 18.3% median (consistently 15-21% across cycles). Decades of per-share intrinsic value compounding under Douglas family stewardship. Net debt of SEK 9.5B is less than 8% of portfolio NAV, and EBIT/interest coverage exceeds 11x.
